import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from stats import average
rnd = random.Random(7)
cases = [[1], [1, 2], [1, 2, 3, 4], [-1, 1], [0], [0.1, 0.2, 0.3], [5, 5, 5], (2, 4), [10**12, 3]]
for _ in range(200):
    n = rnd.randint(1, 20)
    cases.append([rnd.choice([rnd.randint(-1000, 1000), rnd.uniform(-1e3, 1e3)]) for _ in range(n)])
for c in cases:
    exp = sum(c) / len(c)
    got = average(c)
    if abs(got - exp) > 1e-9 * max(1.0, abs(exp)):
        sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
